g.text: Textbook Pipeline and Strategy Pattern: Multi-Root Ingestion, Short-Circuit Cascade, Vision AI and Inode Hardlinking
• Groups candidate files by byte size
• Passes only potential collisions to cascade
Zero disk reads for unique sizes
LAYER 2: TIERED MATCHER CASCADE (CHAIN OF RESPONSIBILITY)
• 128 KB QuickHash: Reads first 64KB + last 64KB buffer
• Eliminates 95% of same-size file collisions with <0.1ms latency
• Only candidates with matching QuickHash proceed to Full SHA-256
Output: Collision Buckets → Full Byte Verification
• Streaming SHA-256: 64KB buffered stream (O(1) memory usage)
• 100% Cryptographic Guarantee: Zero false positive collisions
• Short-Circuit: Exact duplicates are pruned immediately!
Matched files bypass heavy AI/media stages completely
• Catches: Burst shots, crops, color filters, 4K vs 720p transcodes
• Inference: Batched CPU SIMD / AVX2 (No GPU required)
In-memory ZIP/TAR central directory peek without disk unpack
Catches 4K vs 1080p MP4 re-encodes and cloned backup zips
Unmatched files flow sequentially: QuickHash → SHA-256 → AI Vision → Video
As soon as files are matched, they are pruned from candidate pool.
Result: Heavy AI inference runs ONLY on remaining near-duplicates!
• Groups transitive near-duplicate pairs: A ~ B and B ~ C ⇒ {A, B, C}
• Nearly Linear Complexity: Inverse Ackermann O(α(N))
• Partitions whole filesystem into discrete duplicate clusters
Guarantees zero duplicate leakage across multi-folder scans
Zero manual intervention needed to choose master file
• Unifies duplicate directory entries to point to keeper's inode
• 100% Space Reclaim: Duplicates consume 0 additional bytes
• Zero Path Breakage: All existing paths & apps continue working!
• Generates JSON cryptographic rollback manifest with SHA-256
• Preserves directory hierarchy, permissions, and timestamps
